lines.text: The LORD tells Moses He has called Bezalel of the tribe of Judah and filled him with the Spirit of God.
Bezalel is given skill to design works in gold, silver, and bronze, to cut gemstones, and to carve wood.
The LORD selects Oholiab of the tribe of Asher as Bezalel's assistant and gives skill to all the craftsmen.
The LORD tells the Israelites to keep His Sabbaths, saying that for five days work may be done.
When He finishes speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, the LORD gives him two tablets of stone.
